changes.title: Always-load magic usage rules (plugin) + /usage-rules command
acceptance: ponytail-rules.js (project + acts-core embedded + global) injects the magic usage-rules core subset (coding-practices + error-handling) into the system prompt when a magic rules source resolves (usage-rules/ in magic source, deps/magic/usage-rules/ in consumers, or references.magic.path); idempotent PONYTAIL_MAGIC_RULES marker; toggle PONYTAIL_MAGIC_RULES=off; /usage-rules command (all rules by default, named rules or core subset via args) installs project+global via acts ponytail install; npm test + zig build test + node --check pass; acts validate passes
